About the Scholarship

EuroPhotonics is the long-running Erasmus Mundus master in photonics coordinated from Aix-Marseille with partners in Barcelona and Karlsruhe. The 2027-2029 recruitment campaign runs from 1 November 2026 to 4 February 2027, covering photonics engineering, biophotonics and quantum-light specialisations.

OpportunityEuroPhotonics – Erasmus Mundus Master in Photonics
HostEuroPhotonics Consortium (Aix-Marseille)
LocationMarseille (multi-country mobility), France
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
Stipend€1,400/month (EMJM scholarship rate)
Application Deadline4 February 2027
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

EuroPhotonics is the long-running Erasmus Mundus master in photonics coordinated from Aix-Marseille with partners in Barcelona and Karlsruhe. The 2027-2029 recruitment campaign runs from 1 November 2026 to 4 February 2027, covering photonics engineering, biophotonics and quantum-light specialisations.

Programme Highlights

  • Three-university consortium with a strong photonics-industry network
  • Campaign window 1 November 2026 – 4 February 2027
  • Specialisations from biophotonics to quantum technologies
  • Graduates enter laser industry, medtech optics and doctoral programmes

Who Should Apply

Physics, electrical engineering, mechanics or materials-science graduates with solid mathematics and optics basics, per the consortium's entry profile.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs plus monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Submit through the EuroPhotonics application page during the November-February window. Key deadline information: 4 February 2027; recruitment campaign for the 2027-2029 intake runs 1 November 2026 – 4 February 2027.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About EuroPhotonics Consortium (Aix-Marseille)

The EuroPhotonics consortium is coordinated from Aix-Marseille University and delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Photonics with UPC Barcelona and KIT Karlsruhe.

Official website: https://www.europhotonics.org

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 4 February 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
